steps.say: Report the Standard recap at 4:03:17 of The Cartographer's Silence (cs-1) as giving something away, with a note. Until the host lands the JWT library the service refuses every bearer token by design (CU3 research R-2) and this step records 401; once it does, 404 until LB3's import has written a BookImported for this listener, and 200 { reportId, bookId, target, reportedAt } after that, with the note sealed and an error-level log line naming the report (never the note) as the on-call alert.
Send the same report id again, as a retry would: it answers as the first did, records nothing new and raises the alert again (D77).
